summary.text: Cindy Ryu is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 32-Position 1 since 2011, and she is a candidate for Washington State Senate District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Jesse Salomon, also a Democrat.
Her career experience includes working as an insurance agent and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Ryu earned a high school diploma from Centralia High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington in 1980 and a graduate degree from the University of Washington in 1983.
She has been affiliated with the Pacific Northwest Economic Region and the FCC Interagency Advisory Committee.
In the 2023-2024 session Ryu chaired the Innovation, Community & Economic Development, & Veterans Committee and served on the Appropriations and Consumer Protection & Business committees.
